course_name_original: 29727 - Teoría de estructuras y construcciones industriales
course_name_en: Theory of Structures and Industrial Constructions

learning_outcomes.text: Knowledge and ability for the calculation and design of structures and industrial constructions.
Knows the constructive arrangement of the different systems that make up an industrial structure.
Is capable of performing a preliminary design of the most common structural typologies.
Understands and knows how to apply different methods of calculation and analysis of articulated structures.
Understands and knows how to apply different methods of calculation and analysis of rigid-node structures.
Understands and knows how to solve the global stability problem of structures.
Knows and knows how to apply the general regulations on structures and building contained in the Technical Building Code.
Knowledge in basic and technological subjects, which enables them to learn new methods and theories, and provides them with versatility to adapt to new situations.
Ability to solve problems with initiative, decision-making, creativity, critical reasoning, and to communicate and transmit knowledge, skills, and abilities in the field of Industrial Engineering.
Ability to work in a multilingual and multidisciplinary environment.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to the theory of structures.
Analysis, design, and construction of articulated structures.
Analysis, design, and construction of portal frame or rigid-node structures.
teaching_methods: Theory classes (lectures), presenting theoretical concepts with examples
Practical sessions, for familiarization with structural typologies, use of structural calculation tools, and application of industrial construction regulations
Course project work, involving autonomous structural analysis project resolution
assessment_rules: For continuous assessment, a minimum of 5 out of 10 points is required for the course project, and a minimum of 4 out of 10 points for the exam. For global assessment, a minimum of 4.5 out of 10 points is required for the exam. The use of unauthorized materials or electronic devices during evaluation may lead to the withdrawal of the exam and a score of 0. This may also result in disciplinary action.
